scope.flow: L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange interacting with Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager
scope.environment: Solidity smart contract on L2 using Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager

statements.text: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange passes block.timestamp as the deadline argument to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager, so the deadline check compares block.timestamp against the same value and is a no-op.
A transaction calling increaseLiquidityCurrentRange has insufficient gas and may not be mined immediately.
A pending increaseLiquidityCurrentRange transaction is executed at a later time.
The deadline parameter should prevent a pending increaseLiquidityCurrentRange transaction from being executed after its intended deadline.
Malicious actors or MEV bots can execute delayed increaseLiquidityCurrentRange transactions at a disadvantage to the original submitter.

ambiguities: Report does not specify the concrete disadvantage or amount lost to the original submitter.
Report does not state who submits the delayed transaction or whether the attacker is permissionless.
No explicit numeric deadline bound or expected-versus-actual values are given.
